description: This file defines a utility package for launching and managing text editors within the Kubernetes CLI, including environment-based editor selection, shell command construction, and temporary file handling.

classes.name: Editor
classes.description: A struct representing the command-line arguments and shell usage for launching an editor.

methods.name: NewDefaultEditor
methods.description: Creates an Editor instance configured based on environment variables and defaults.

methods.name: LaunchTempFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file from an io.Reader stream, launches an editor on it, and returns the file contents.
